top_violation_types.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Nine Inches if Equipment Greater Than 5 Ft. (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An outdoor structure that consisted of a slide and climbing that measured over 5 feet, did not have the required 9 inches of loose-fill. There was not sufficient enough loose-fill around the structure to rake in place at the time of the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: No Swaddling of Infant Unless Completed Sleep Exception Form on File (26 TAC §746.2428)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An infant was observed swaddled in a blanket while being held by a caregiver.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(10))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The Admission Information Form 2935 has not been updated with the information on a child s ability to swim without assistance.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The promotion of Physical Activity was not available for review in the Operational Policies.

top_violation_types.title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A child did not have their hands washed following a diaper change.
